caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a decorative urn with intricate ornamentation. The main object, placed centrally, is a lidded urn with a broad, rounded body, a short stem, and a circular base. The urn is adorned with elaborate floral and scrollwork designs, with a prominent cartouche on the front displaying a monogram "P W" topped by a crown. The lid is domed and decorated with similar motifs, terminating in a fluted central knob. To the right of the urn is a circular top view of the lid, showing the central floral motif and radiating grooves. Below this is a horizontal decorative border design featuring floral elements and scrolls similar to those on the urn. In the upper left corner, there is a small inset diagram depicting the urn’s profile with measurements: 4¾ inches in width and 6½ inches in height. The entire image is rendered in grayscale using fine pencil shading, and the composition is arranged on a beige, lightly textured background.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
